scientific_integrity: All stated formulas have an analytic proof. Monte Carlo and symbolic checks corroborate it; comparison with earlier distance results is explicit, and no independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Requires labeled dimensionless affine coordinates and exact conditional moments; identifies opposing-facet weights, not the full physical metric or skew-parallelotope shape. Noise stability and priority against uninspected historical texts are not established.
title: The dimension-three threshold for tomography by random boundary-chord midpoints
